about_the_game:
When Livia Disappeared is a fantasy visual novel about Magick, memories, and exploring your past to survive the present. After an attempt at performing a ritual from an old grimoire goes horribly wrong, Livia seeks out a secret Order to save her friend. She learns that she has the power not only to travel between worlds, but also to alter the past to change the present.
She has three days to save her friend – but the Order has a different agenda. 

Key Features

Uncover the dark secrets of the members of the Order – and those who oppose it
Three different, branching character routes will lead you to uncover not only their demons, but also your own suppressed memories. How far you are willing to go for what you believe in, for others’ expectations, and for finding somewhere to belong?

Experience the beauty and danger of rituals
Create and perform rituals inspired by ceremonial Magick, and deal with the consequences of how it changes the worlds around you.

Craft potions and experience their effects
Mix potions from mystical ingredients, and experience how they change your perception of the world on the Other Side.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains references to death, grief, trauma, and mental distress. It includes fictional depictions of ritual practices, mild fantasy violence, and the use of alchemical elixirs.

Certain story paths explore emotionally intense topics, including implied manipulation and coercion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd generation) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (integrated graphics supported)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 resolution recommended for best experience. Compatible with both mouse/keyboard and most gamepads.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th generation) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU such as NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 resolution recommended for best experience. Compatible with both mouse/keyboard and most gamepads.

short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in the 1920s. Perform ritual magic, craft potions, and uncover the secrets of the Order that maintains the balance between worlds.
